overview:
TX-18 is a heavily Democratic Houston-area seat with a +29 partisan lean. Christian Menefee, the Democratic incumbent, enters the general election after raising $3.6 million and benefiting from more than $7 million in outside support, with no recorded outside spending against him. Republican Ronald Whitfield has reported minimal financial activity.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, the money gap, and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win near 96%. The expected margin is roughly 29 points, with elevated uncertainty given the absence of polling.
